about: Named surfaces the style instruments (shoot.mjs, e2e/perf-vitals.spec.ts) know how to reach. `path` may carry {placeholders}; each is resolved by `resolve.<name>.sql`, run READ-ONLY against the throwaway data copy the run serves. `root` is the element that must mount (present, at least minHeight px tall - default 120 - and at least minText chars of text - default 40) or the shot fails; the workspace tabs raise minText to 200 because main#main carries the tab header before the body streams in. `tab` is the workspace tab id (app/features/shell/tabs.ts) for the warm-switch measurement. `gate: true` = one of the kit-unification gate surfaces; the rest are reference-quality surfaces to compare against. docs/design/instruments.md is the operator page.

token.sql: SELECT token FROM offers ORDER BY (status = 'extended') DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1
token.why: the candidate offer door; prefers a still-open offer, else the newest one (the demo corpus carries an accepted and an expired one)

token.sql: SELECT access_token FROM skill_profiles WHERE revoked_at IS NULL AND access_token IS NOT NULL ORDER BY issued_at DESC LIMIT 1
token.why: the public Durable Skill Profile card. The demo corpus has no evaluated dev-case submission, so the `skill-profile` seed inserts ONE into the throwaway copy and mints it through POST /api/devcase/skill-profile (the real signing path) when nothing is found

journey.note: the Journeys full-viewport overlay above the workspace

slug.sql: SELECT slug FROM analyses WHERE workspace_id = 'workspace' ORDER BY created_at DESC, slug LIMIT 1
slug.why: the newest saved analysis report in the default workspace

me.note: reference-quality surface: the job-seeker profile & CV studio
